Album Cover Tunnel preview for the guitar workbench

Official component: https://leibox.pantoria.cn/docs/animations/album-cover-tunnel
Source package: https://leibox.pantoria.cn/ai/packages/album-cover-tunnel/vanilla.json
Component author: LeiShiFu; upstream license: LEIBOX-LICENSE.md.
Three.js 0.185.1: see three/LICENSE.

Original source checksums are verified by scripts/fetch-tunnel.mjs.
Local adaptations: remove unused embedded demonstration covers; add the .js
extension to the runtime import; strip TypeScript types for browser execution.
The application supplies its existing song artwork. Artwork rights remain
with their respective rights holders.

This is an isolated application preview, not a standalone component library.
No tunnel code is loaded by the normal workbench homepage or score reader.
